title: Return Fee Basis When the Customer Holds a New Kestrel Contract or Lease
content:
**Loyalty terms — return fee basis.** For a vehicle returned under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the basis of the return fee depends on the customer's new Kestrel holdings dated around the return date:

1. Where the customer holds an active **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**, an active **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract** or an active **Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract** whose lease date or contract date falls within 30 calendar days before or after the return date (the return-fee loyalty days, 30 on every tier), the return fee is waived and is zero.
2. Where the customer holds no such contract but holds an active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease whose lease date falls within 90 calendar days before or after the return date, the return fee is the lower of the return fee for the contract's tier and the disposition fee of that lease.
3. Otherwise the return fee is the return fee for the contract's tier.

The records read are the status and lease date (and, for the second branch, the disposition fee) of the customer's leases, and the status and contract date of the customer's new-vehicle and pre-owned retail contracts. Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one; a holding dated exactly 30 (or 90) days away is within the span.

## Decision table (hypothetical tier return fee USD 450.00)

| Customer's active holdings | Basis |
|---|---|
| Pre-owned retail contract dated 12 days after the return | 0.00 (waived) |
| Lease dated 30 days before the return | 0.00 (waived) |
| Lease dated 31 days before, disposition fee 395.00 | 395.00 |
| Lease dated 75 days after, disposition fee 595.00 | 450.00 |
| Lease dated 91 days after; nothing else near | 450.00 |
| New-vehicle retail contract dated 45 days after; no lease | 450.00 |
